answer_1.quote: To test multi-token text generation quality, we evaluate the models based on perplexity.
answer_1.outputs: open-ended text for sentence completion and instruction-following

answer_2.quote: For a three-token model, we calculate PPL₁, PPL₁:2, and PPL₁:3. We can also extend perplexity calculation to dynamic multi-token prediction, wherein we decide n based on the joint probability distribution and the back-off threshold. We refer to it as PPLᴅ.

answer_3.quote: For single-mode evaluation, we ask GPT-3.5 to score the generated response from one to ten. For pairwise evaluation, we ask GPT-3.5 to compare the response against one generated by the corresponding Pythia base model.
